clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Gazin Tenorm keeps watch near the altar after a dangerous scouting mission in Elwynn Forest.

Gazin Tenorm stays in the Cathedral of Light, though his thoughts remain in Elwynn Forest. He and his close friend Henze Faulk went into the woods to gather proof of the Defias Brotherhood's movements for the royal court. Defias forces ambushed them. Gazin escaped to Stormwind, but Henze was left in mortal danger. Now Gazin seeks a hero of the Light to help his companion.
